title: Pullback square for normalized completed-to-native maps
statement: Given a family m of maps from completed coefficients to native coefficients and a family C of normalized CoefficientPresentation records with m T = (C T).integralMap l T for every scheme T, the maps m satisfy the inverse-image square for every scheme morphism.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2 and Section 6.8; finite quotient pullback comparison

proof.text: Rewrite each m T using hC T. The resulting equality is exactly the explicit normalized integral-map pullback square.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 6.8.2 and Section 6.8; wrapper reduction to the explicit integral-map square

from.place: Lemma 6.8.2 and Section 6.8; finite quotient pullback comparison
